input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://xi.li.org/util/ref#>
SELECT ?x ?class ?id WHERE {
  ?x a brick:ElectricPowerSensor .
  ?x brick:hasPointType ?pt .
  ?class a ?pt .
  ?x ref:hasTimeseriesId ?id .
  FILTER(?pt = brick:ElectricPower || ?pt = brick:LightingPower)
}
SELECT DISTINCT ?class WHERE { ?x a ?class . FILTER( STRSTARTS(STR(?class), "https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#") ) }

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT ?x ?id WHERE {
  ?x brick:ref:hasTimeseriesId ?id .
  ?x brick:isPointOf ?p .
  ?p a brick:Building_Electrical_Meter .
  ?p ?o ?x .
}

PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
SELECT ?sensor ?cls ?point ?tsref WHERE {
  ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference ?e .
  ?e ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsref .
  ?sensor a ?cls .
  ?sensor qudt:hasUnit ?u .
  FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?u), "joule") || STRSTARTS(STR(?u), "hour"))
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?sensor ?cls ?point ?tsref WHERE {
  ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference ?e .
  ?e ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsref .
  ?sensor a ?cls .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(STR(?cls), "Electrical") || CONTAINS(STR(?sensor), "Meter"))
}

import csv
from collections import defaultdict
target = {
 "7f297e37-40eb-5a74-a1ce-c242bf4b26aa",
 "14c164b8-1957-5aa7-961c-a3ad951900da",
 "1b318110-05c1-54b3-8fea-315f5900b64a",
 "1689d963-4d6f-57dc-8368-b7b6ce076ca4",
 "1b3eb9e6-d753-5328-bf35-516ad86dafc4",
}
bldg = "43017c43-0ad2-5eef-8e41-95a8780d3143"
lit_hour = defaultdict(float)
bldg_hour = defaultdict(float)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        ts = row['timeseries_id']
        t = row['timestamp']
        v = float(row['value'])
        day = t[:10]
        if day != '2018-04-11':
            continue
        if ts in target:
            lit_hour[row['timestamp']] += v
        elif ts == bldg:
            bldg_hour[row['timestamp']] += v
lighting_J = sum(lit_hour.values()) * 3600   # W * s -> J
bldg_J = sum(bldg_hour.values())            # already J
print("lights hours:", len(lit_hour), "bldg hours:", len(bldg_hour))
print("lighting_J:", lighting_J, "bldg_J:", bldg_J)
print("fraction:", lighting_J/bldg_J)
